recent_posts.title: Hibernate Tools merges into Hibernate ORM 7.4 and Eclipse tooling retires
recent_posts.summary: Starting with Hibernate ORM 7.4, the core modules of Hibernate Tools are being merged directly into the Hibernate ORM repository. The move eliminates the need for separate release coordination since the tools were always tightly coupled to ORM internals. The group ID changes from org.hibernate.tool to org.hibernate.orm, and the Maven/Gradle plugins are unified with existing ORM plugins. Eclipse-based tooling from JBoss Tools is no longer officially maintained; the code has been extracted to a personal GitHub repo and archived. Developers relying on Eclipse plugins are advised to switch to the Maven or Gradle plugins instead. Migration requires updating dependency coordinates and import statements (e.g., org.hibernate.tool.api moves to org.hibernate.tool.reveng.api).

recent_posts.title: Jakarta Persistence 4.0 Milestone 2 released with criteria query and EntityGraph improvements
recent_posts.summary: Jakarta Persistence 4.0 Milestone 2 has been released with several new features. Key additions include improvements to criteria queries with specialized expression types (ComparableExpression, TextExpression, etc.) that reduce verbosity, enhanced EntityGraph API with a new FetchOption interface and built-in BatchSize support, a new @EntityListener annotation that decouples listeners from entity classes, finer flush control via FlushModeType.EXPLICIT and QueryFlushMode, a StatementOrTypedQuery type for better type safety, and a @Discoverable meta-annotation enabling any class to host annotations like @NamedQuery in Jakarta EE containers.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate ORM 7.3 release highlights
recent_posts.summary: Hibernate ORM 7.3 Final has been released, with 7.3.1 following shortly after. Key new features include a KeyType enum enabling find() and findMultiple() to load entities by natural id, a new @NaturalIdClass annotation for modeling non-aggregated composite natural ids (similar to @IdClass for identifiers), and support for Jackson 3 JSON and XML FormatMapper implementations.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate Reactive 4.3.0.Final released with Hibernate ORM 7.3 and Vert.x 5 support
recent_posts.summary: Hibernate Reactive 4.3.0.Final has been released. This version is compatible with Hibernate ORM 7.3.0.Final and Vert.x SQL client 5.0.8. A compatibility matrix is available on the Hibernate website for those needing compatibility with older releases.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate Search 8.3.0.Final released with updated dependencies
recent_posts.summary: Hibernate Search 8.3.0.Final has been released. This version is nearly identical to the 8.3.0.CR1 candidate release, with the main changes being dependency upgrades to align with Hibernate ORM 7.3.0.Final. Other dependency updates include Elasticsearch 9.3 and client 9.3.2, OpenSearch 3.4/3.5 and client 3.5.0, Lucene 10.4.0 for the Lucene-next backend, and AWS SDK 2.42.14. Hibernate Search 8.3 is a drop-in replacement for 8.2 assuming dependencies are also upgraded.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate Search 6.2.5, 7.2.6, 8.1.3 and 8.2.2 maintenance releases
recent_posts.summary: Maintenance releases for Hibernate Search across four version lines (6.2.5.Final, 7.2.6.Final, 8.1.3.Final, and 8.2.2.Final) are now available. Changes include dependency upgrades (Hibernate ORM, Lucene 9.12.3, Elasticsearch client 9.1.5, Avro, GSON), bug fixes such as conditional search failure when sorting by nullable fields and incorrect document update instead of deletion on cascading OneToOne deletes, and minor improvements like passing ROOT locale to loggers.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate Search 8.3.0.CR1 released with ORM 7.3 and Elasticsearch 9.3 support
recent_posts.summary: Hibernate Search 8.3.0.CR1 has been released as the first candidate release of the next minor version. Key updates include compatibility with Hibernate ORM 7.3, Elasticsearch 9.3, and OpenSearch 3.4, along with upgrades to the Elasticsearch REST clients and AWS SDK 2.41.2. It is a drop-in replacement for Hibernate Search 8.2 assuming dependency upgrades are also applied.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate Reactive 4.3.0.CR1 released
recent_posts.summary: Hibernate Reactive 4.3.0.CR1 has been released. This candidate release is compatible with Hibernate ORM 7.3.0.CR2 and Vert.x SQL client 5.0.7. A compatibility matrix for older versions is available on the Hibernate website. Links to documentation, issue tracker, forums, and community channels are provided.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate ORM 7.3.0.CR2 release candidate now available
recent_posts.summary: Hibernate ORM 7.3.0.CR2, a second release candidate for the 7.3 series, has been published. Details and resources are available on the GitHub releases page.

recent_posts.title: Hibernate ORM 8.0.0.Alpha1 released with JPA 4.0 support
recent_posts.summary: Hibernate ORM 8.0.0.Alpha1 has been released, implementing support for JPA 4.0 (first milestone). Most features are implemented, with a few remaining items such as default fetch type for to-one associations and @ExcludedFromVersioning. Release details are available on GitHub, and JPA 4.0 specifics are covered in a separate post.
